name: atuin_output
description: Retrieve captured command output by history ID. For the latest command, use the ID in turn context directly. Request focused inclusive line ranges, including negative endpoints for the tail; avoid fetching large outputs in full. Returned lines have one-based numbers and tabs.

history_id.description: History entry identifier from history results or turn context.

ranges.description: Inclusive zero-based [start, end] line pairs; negative endpoints count backward. Advertised default: [[0,1000]], but this CLI fetches all output when omitted or empty; send explicit ranges to bound retrieval.
